contract:
Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::borrowBook(uid: String,barcode: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		user: User = User.allInstances()->any(candidate: User|candidate.UserID = uid),
		copy: BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstances()->any(candidate: BookCopy|candidate.Barcode = barcode),
		student: Student = Student.allInstances()->any(candidate: Student|candidate.UserID = uid),
		faculty: Faculty = Faculty.allInstances()->any(candidate: Faculty|candidate.UserID = uid),
		reservation: Reserve = Reserve.allInstances()->any(candidate: Reserve|candidate.ReservedUser = user and
		candidate.ReservedCopy = copy and
		candidate.IsReserveClosed = false),
		dueDate: Date = if user.oclIsTypeOf(Student) 
		then Today.After(30) 
		else Today.After(60) 
		endif 
	precondition:
		User.allInstances()->exists(candidate: User|candidate.UserID = uid) and
		BookCopy.allInstances()->exists(candidate: BookCopy|candidate.Barcode = barcode) and
		user.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus::NORMAL and
		user.SuspensionDays = 0 and
		(if user.oclIsTypeOf(Student) 
		then if student.Programme = Programme::BACHELOR 
		then user.LoanedNumber<20 
		else if student.Programme = Programme::MASTER 
		then user.LoanedNumber<40 
		else user.LoanedNumber<60 
		endif  
		endif  
		else if user.oclIsTypeOf(Faculty) 
		then user.LoanedNumber<60 
		else false 
		endif  
		endif ) and
		(copy.Status = CopyStatus::AVAILABLE or
		(copy.Status = CopyStatus::ONHOLDSHELF and
		copy.IsReserved = true and
		Reserve.allInstances()->exists(candidate: Reserve|candidate.ReservedUser = user and
		candidate.ReservedCopy = copy and
		candidate.IsReserveClosed = false)))
	postcondition:
		let loan: Loan in
		loan.oclIsNew() and
		Loan.allInstances()->includes(loan) and
		loan.LoanedUser = user and
		loan.LoanedCopy = copy and
		user.LoanedBook->includes(loan) and
		copy.LoanedRecord->includes(loan) and
		loan.LoanDate = Today and
		loan.IsReturned = false and
		loan.DueDate = dueDate and
		user.LoanedNumber = user.LoanedNumber@pre+1 and
		copy.Status = CopyStatus::LOANED and
		loan.OverDue3Days = false and
		loan.OverDue10Days = false and
		loan.OverDue17Days = false and
		loan.OverDue31Days = false and
		(if copy.Status@pre = CopyStatus::ONHOLDSHELF 
		then copy.IsReserved = false and
		reservation.IsReserveClosed = true 
		else copy.IsReserved = copy.IsReserved@pre 
		endif ) and
		result = true
}
